task.title: Phase dev root deployment around persistent runtime closure

scope.owned_layer: Phased dev root deployment isolating persistent runtime from bounded verification, candidate image build before active runtime mutation, and deploy contract tests
not_changing: No secondary scheduler, watchdog, or retry queues
Source Ingestion reconcile-only default posture with no continuous external provider pull
Release admission isolation: failed phase preserves unswitched public frontend and BFF pair

behavioral_proof.persistent_runtime_profile_isolation: Dev root deployment activates only openclaw compose profile for persistent runtime; retires inactive profile containers via retire_dormant_and_one_off_profile_containers, and keeps dormant smokes (experiments, finrl, qlib, rllib, ray-tune, trl under dormant-smoke) and one-off smokes (activation-ready-smoke, openclaw-activation-ready-e2e, smoke, source-search-bounded, lifecycle-capacity-benchmark) out of default root deploy
behavioral_proof.build_before_mutate: Candidate images are built and validated (docker compose config and docker compose build) prior to container recreation/rollout (docker compose up -d)
behavioral_proof.source_ingest_reconcile_only: Source ingestion controller defaults to reconcile_only mode with unless-stopped restart policy, no second scheduler, and no continuous external pull
behavioral_proof.phase_failure_preserves_release_pair: Any phase failure stops deployment, causes bff_fe_pair_verified=false, and prevents coordinate-dev-release from admitting or switching frontend/BFF release pair
behavioral_proof.post_up_failure_rollback_and_compensatio: If any post-rollout verification gate fails after container recreation, the remote deploy script and nonprod-deploy workflow automatically roll back the dev operator-bff and lifecycle projector to the captured baseline commit under lease, preserving the prior exact public FE/BFF pair. Compensation is mutation-aware (skipping rollback deploy when the active BFF is already at the baseline rollback SHA, and restoring baseline when mutated), acquires its own dedicated rollback lease (--expected-backend-sha bound to baseline) with an identity-bound heartbeat loop running under TARGET_ENV=dev with process group isolation, binds nested rollback strictly to the baseline SHA (PANTHEON_DEV_ROLLBACK_BACKEND_SHA and --rollback-sha) so post-up failures during baseline compensation deploy skip rollback rather than restoring the failed candidate, forwards the complete governed BFF environment (JWT/OIDC, 5 dev login actor credentials, adapter token, MFA, role maps), inner rollback preserves all PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_* mappings to Compose PANTHEON_BFF_*, and contract tests enforce strict credential and config presence.
behavioral_proof.bounded_compensation_budget_and_contenti: Deploy-dev job timeout-minutes=120 (7200s) accommodates initial lease acquisition wait (1800s) + initial deploy deadline (1200s) + root paper bootstrap timeout (420s) + public smoke timeout (300s) + rollback lease acquisition wait (1800s) + rollback compensation deadline (1200s) = 6720s, leaving 480s headroom for preflights, image builds, and post-rollback verifications, proving rollback reachability before GitHub runner timeout. In deploy_compensation, the step deadline timeout-minutes=60 (3600s) accommodates configured rollback lease wait (1800s) + rollback deploy deadline (1200s) = 3000s, leaving 600s headroom for bounded predecessor heartbeat stop, identity verification, probes, and release cleanup. In deploy_compensation, stop_predecessor_heartbeat verifies predecessor heartbeat identity before sending SIGTERM, rechecks identity before SIGKILL escalation, and verifies process termination after KILL loop, failing closed (exit 75) if mismatched or un-stoppable. All hosted curls in public_smoke and deploy_compensation are bounded with --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 and enclosing step deadlines (5m and 60m). Active-lease contention against the quarantined predecessor lease is modeled and proven: rollback acquisition polls and takes over the expired lease, restoratively executes baseline deploy under TARGET_ENV=dev, and releases the lease upon success.
